description:
SOURCES SOUGHT

DLA Weapons Support (Columbus) is preparing to solicit a long-term contract for the NSN 2540-013859000. This announcement is considered market research in accordance with FAR Part 10. The solicitation will be synopsized separately later. The purpose of this notice is to identify qualified business concerns interested in submitting a proposal on the below listed NSN.

Item details are as follows:

NSN 2540-013859000

WINDSHIELD WASHER PUMP & RESERVOIR ASSY

Estimated Annual Demand Quantity (ADQ) – 9,678

Unit of Issue – Each

North American Industry Classification System Codes (NAICS) – 336320

NAICS Business Size – 1,000

The associated drawing number is listed below:

IAW REFERENCE DRAWING NR (19207) 12342885

Sources interested in submitting a proposal on this forthcoming solicitation should complete the attached market survey questionnaire and spreadsheet and return the completed copies to Samantha Simms at samantha.simms@dla.mil by May 4th, 2026.

Notice Attachments Include:

1. Market Research Questionnaire

2. Market Research NSN Spreadsheet

3. Product Item Description (PID)
